mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly real GDP growth (GDPC1) signals robust economic expansion, increasing corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through improved profit visibility.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth is positive (as measured by latest quarterly report).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 5.5% indicates labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending power and corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and decline in employment (PAYEMS) signals aggressive monetary tightening amid labor weakness, compressing equity valuations through higher discount rates and reduced earnings growth.
failure_condition: The interaction term (FEDFUNDS * PAYEMS) shows Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window, or negative returns are not observed when both series move in the predicted direction.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%) triggers anticipated Federal Reserve rate hikes, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuation multiples, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strong manufacturing activity and supply chain resilience, boosting corporate margins and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through immediate earnings momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO growth is positive.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) falling below 1000 thousand units signals weakening residential construction, reducing consumer wealth and discretionary spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1000.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates broad consumer spending weakness, reducing corporate revenue visibility and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (RSAFS * HOUST) shows Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window, or negative returns are not observed when both series decline.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market recovery (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM) supports consumer spending and corporate hiring, increasing earnings growth expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth > 0.5%.
